shared_design_prompt: Generate a high-resolution portrait single-screen ROZZ mobile app design concept. One complete front-on slim graphite Android phone with centered tiny punch-hole camera, equal generous margins, no angled perspective, no cropped device, softly shadowed on warm gray studio background. Screen proportions 390x844. Premium playful editorial finance style based on rounded pastel block panels, giant precise financial numbers, clean spacious transaction lists, compact rounded bottom dock. DARK screen canvas charcoal #141618, neutral surface #232629, text warm ivory #F5F2EA and secondary #B9BDB7. PASTELS mint #C6E7D4 for balance, butter #F2D884 for MAB, lilac #D7CEF2 for insights, blush #F0C7CF for spending. Dark ink #18231D on all pastel panels. Primary action soft lime #D4EFA1. LIGHT variant uses warm cream #F7F4ED background, ivory neutral surfaces, dark ink text; same pastel roles. No gradients, no glassmorphism, no gold banking aesthetic, no excessive nested cards, no glossy 3d coins, no random marketing imagery. Typography: Syne-like bold expressive short headings, DM Sans-like clear body at least 14px, large clean tabular numbers with rupee ₹ glyph. 24px side padding, 8pt rhythm, 28px main panel radius, 16px controls, 48px minimum tap targets, obvious accessible text contrast. Rounded custom consistent 2px stroke icon family. Status bar 9:41. For main app tabs use exactly five bottom destinations in order Home, Activity, Rozz, Insights, MAB, with visible labels and soft lime active item. Detail/settings/onboarding screens have a back arrow and no tab dock unless specified. Never show send money, transfer, deposits, card issuance, credit scores or bank login since ROZZ is an SMS-based personal finance tracker. No real personal information, only clearly synthetic sample numbers and merchant names. Do not add extra outside captions or design labels. Deliver a readable carefully typeset plausible app UI, not a moodboard.
reference: 01-home-dark.png used for the visual system of subsequent screens
